T1_section_classifiability.reading: Real and the conditioned generator should both beat baseline; the unconditioned one should sit near it. That shows section-conditioning is necessary and sufficient to reproduce the Voynich's topicality.

verdict.summary: section-conditioning is necessary (unconditioned loses topicality) and, with calibrated copying, reproduces both the topicality and the page statistics - a complete generative model of a topical-not-referential text
